statement: Fix the constructed tuple with later accuracy t, put k = kt, and use its final segments R ∈ Rbase and original owner sets IR from Equation (5.28). On an owned cell of depth s, define Yl = Bl + Ul, Bi = Xi, Bj = Xj, Ui = Uj = 0, Be = Pnew e,s Fe,s − ge,prev,I, Ue = (Pnew e,s+K0 − Pnew e,s )Fe,s (e = a, b), ∥Bl,I∥2,I, ∥Ul,I∥2,I, ∥Yl,I∥2,I ≤ C, Λk = C(1 + K0) log(2Dbase) ≤ kC , X I∈IR |I|∥Ue,I∥2 2,I ≤ Λ2 k|R| (e = a, b). (5.29) Each Bl is a signed sum of at most two current nested-catalog projections applied to Fl,s. Their basic catalogs have distinct private directions and inherited masks. Their path counts, column sizes, inverse private weights, bounded scalar atom complexities, and current coefficient sums are bounded by Dbase, with ek ≤ Dbase ≤ exp(kC ). For t ≥ 12, the associated full Y tuple has the pair bound and pointwise form bound η of Equa- tion (5.27). For three available basic scalar columns φ in distinct slots, let actI(φ) be their form norm against a normalized L2(I) input in the fourth slot. For a sufficiently large fixed Cact, put AR = n I ∈ IR : actI(φ) > D−Cact base for some available triple φ o . This common active set has path multiplicity X I∈AR 1I(y) ≤ M ≤ DC base. Define three patterns in their original slots by z∅ l = Bl for every l, za a = Ua, za l = Bl (l ̸= a), zb b = Ub, zb l = Bl (l ̸= b), P = {z∅ , za , zb }. POINTWISE CONVERGENCE OF TRIPLE AVERAGES 41 For z ∈ P, let MR(z) := X I∈AR |I| min{η, |HI(zI)|}. (5.30) Then for t ≥ 12, X I∈IR |I| |HI(YI)| ≤ CηΛ2 k|R| + e−k |R| + X z∈P MR(z). (5.31) The e−k|R| term is the total inactive error for the three patterns. The finitely many leading accuracy levels have a bound independent of the number of spatial depths. These base data and their estimates hold anew on normalized subroots with the inherited basic lists and their local continuations.
